tools.name: accessibility_html-audit
tools.description: Run the static image, heading, form, link, language, keyboard, ARIA, and inline-contrast checks before you ship a page or UI change. The result is not a WCAG conformance claim. Call with optional url, html. Returns checkedAt, wcagCompliance, source, url, warnings, counts, and issues (counts includes

tools.name: accessibility_image-alt-text-audit
tools.description: Flag images, image inputs, and areas with no alt attribute before you ship a page or UI change. An empty alt is reported as a manual check, not as a confirmed failure. Call with optional url, html. Returns checkedAt, wcagCompliance, source, url, warnings, and issues (issues includes kind, code, elem

tools.name: accessibility_heading-structure-audit
tools.description: Read heading elements in source order and flag empty headings and skipped levels before you ship a page or UI change. A missing h1 is a potential issue, not a confirmed failure. Call with optional url, html. Returns checkedAt, wcagCompliance, source, url, warnings, headings, and issues (headings inc

tools.name: accessibility_form-audit
tools.description: Check that controls have a label, an aria-label, or a matching label element before you ship a page or UI change. A placeholder or title is not treated as a sufficient name. Call with optional url, html. Returns checkedAt, wcagCompliance, source, url, warnings, and issues (issues includes kind, code

tools.name: accessibility_link-audit
tools.description: Flag links with no accessible name before you ship a page or UI change. Generic text such as click here is a potential issue because the surrounding sentence was not judged. Call with optional url, html. Returns checkedAt, wcagCompliance, source, url, warnings, and issues (issues includes kind, code

tools.name: accessibility_document-language-check
tools.description: Read the lang attribute on the html element before you ship a page or UI change. The page text is not compared with that value, and a fragment without html is not marked as a failure. Call with optional url, html. Returns checkedAt, wcagCompliance, source, url, warnings, language, languageStatus, an

tools.name: accessibility_keyboard-signals
tools.description: Flag a positive tabindex and an onclick on a non-control before you ship a page or UI change. Keys are not pressed, so keyboard operation stays a manual check. Call with optional url, html. Returns checkedAt, wcagCompliance, source, url, warnings, and issues (issues includes kind, code, element, exp

tools.name: accessibility_aria-attribute-audit
tools.description: Check roles, boolean ARIA values, and references to ids that exist in this HTML before you ship a page or UI change. Runtime ARIA state changes are not tested. Call with optional url, html. Returns checkedAt, wcagCompliance, source, url, warnings, and issues (issues includes kind, code, element, exp

tools.name: accessibility_color-contrast-check
tools.description: Calculate a contrast ratio only when both colours are opaque values on the same element before you ship a page or UI change. A single colour is not compared with an assumed background. Call with optional url, html. Returns checkedAt, wcagCompliance, source, url, warnings, and issues (issues includes

tools.name: accessibility_remediation-report
tools.description: Combine the static checks and list confirmed issues before potential issues and manual checks. The report does not claim WCAG conformance. Call with optional url, html. Returns checkedAt, wcagCompliance, source, url, warnings, summary, counts, and issues (counts includes confirmed, potential, manual
